contract_identity.purpose: Select the active governing Design Brain family from whole-beam state before the selected family runs its internal strategy ladder.
contract_identity.live_classification_owner: legacy page classification paths until migration

global_protection_rules: Never optimise an overdesigned check in a way that causes a failing check to worsen.
Never reduce shared geometry for optimisation if that shared geometry is required to repair a failing check.
Never allow inactive-family recommendations to publish.
Mixed strengthen-and-optimise families may only optimise the overdesigned check where the failing check is unchanged or improved.
Classification selects the governing family only. It must not define the internal strategy ladder for that family.

EXACT_STOP_PROVEN.condition_summary: exact_stop_available is true and all active strength/serviceability checks are acceptable
select_when: all active strength/serviceability checks are acceptable
must_not_select_when: a repair or optimisation remains required and available
locked/no-repair conditions govern first
EXACT_STOP_PROVEN.purpose: Terminal result where the design is already as close as possible or no better valid move exists.

LOCKED_NO_REPAIR.condition_summary: repair or optimisation is required, but locked inputs or no-valid-repair proof prevent all valid paths
select_when: a repair or optimisation is required
locked inputs prevent all valid repair/optimisation paths OR no_valid_repair_available == true
must_not_select_when: a valid unlocked repair or optimisation path exists
LOCKED_NO_REPAIR.purpose: Terminal result where no legal action can be taken.

must_not_select_when: only one strength domain fails
terminal exact-stop or locked-no-repair applies
BENDING_AND_SHEAR_FAIL_GOVERN.purpose: Combined strengthening. Neither bending nor shear should be solved in isolation.

BENDING_FAIL_SHEAR_OPTIMISE_GOVERNS.condition_summary: bending fails, shear is overdesigned, and shear can be optimised without hurting bending
must_not_select_when: shear optimisation would reduce bending capacity
shear optimisation would push bending further from the target band
shared depth/width reduction is required while bending still fails or worsens
BENDING_FAIL_SHEAR_OPTIMISE_GOVERNS.purpose: Strengthen bending while safely reducing shear overdesign.
protection: shear optimisation must not reduce bending capacity or push bending further from the target band
do not reduce shared depth/width for shear optimisation if bending still fails or worsens

SHEAR_FAIL_BENDING_OPTIMISE_GOVERNS.condition_summary: shear fails, bending is overdesigned, and bending can be optimised without hurting shear
must_not_select_when: bending optimisation would reduce shear capacity
bending optimisation would push shear further from the target band
shared depth/width reduction is required while shear still fails or worsens
SHEAR_FAIL_BENDING_OPTIMISE_GOVERNS.purpose: Strengthen shear while safely reducing bending overdesign.
protection: bending optimisation must not reduce shear capacity or push shear further from the target band
do not reduce shared depth/width for bending optimisation if shear still fails or worsens

BENDING_FAIL_GOVERNS.condition_summary: bending fails and shear is protected, acceptable, or cannot be safely optimised
must_not_select_when: combined bending and shear failure is active
BENDING_FAIL_SHEAR_OPTIMISE_GOVERNS is eligible
terminal exact-stop or locked-no-repair applies
BENDING_FAIL_GOVERNS.purpose: Bending-only strengthening using the selected BENDING_FAIL_GOVERNS family contract. Internal strategy details are excluded from this classification contract.

SHEAR_FAIL_GOVERNS.condition_summary: shear fails and bending is protected, acceptable, or cannot be safely optimised
must_not_select_when: combined bending and shear failure is active
SHEAR_FAIL_BENDING_OPTIMISE_GOVERNS is eligible
terminal exact-stop or locked-no-repair applies
SHEAR_FAIL_GOVERNS.purpose: Shear-only strengthening using the selected SHEAR_FAIL_GOVERNS family contract. Internal strategy details are excluded from this classification contract.

SERVICEABILITY_GOVERNS.condition_summary: strength checks do not fail and serviceability_state == "FAIL"
must_not_select_when: strength failure has higher priority and is not terminally blocked

COMBINED_OVERDESIGN.condition_summary: bending and shear are both overdesigned or both have minimum-reinforcement blocker evidence, and both can be safely reduced or stopped together
select_when: both can be safely reduced or both have active family-owned blocker evidence
must_not_select_when: any active strength or serviceability failure governs
only one domain is overdesigned

BENDING_OVERDESIGN_GOVERNS.condition_summary: bending is overdesigned or stopped by minimum bending reinforcement while shear is protected
must_not_select_when: bending is an active strength failure
serviceability failure governs
terminal exact-stop or locked-no-repair applies
BENDING_OVERDESIGN_GOVERNS.purpose: Reduce bending overdesign while protecting shear.

SHEAR_OVERDESIGN_GOVERNS.condition_summary: shear is overdesigned or stopped by minimum shear reinforcement while bending is protected
must_not_select_when: shear is an active strength failure
serviceability failure governs
terminal exact-stop or locked-no-repair applies
SHEAR_OVERDESIGN_GOVERNS.purpose: Reduce shear overdesign while protecting bending.

TARGET_BAND_REACHED.condition_summary: both strength utilisations are in target, serviceability does not fail, and geometry/detailing is not blocked
must_not_select_when: any active strength or serviceability failure governs
valid overdesign cleanup remains selected

field_types.classification_hash: stable hash of normalized classification result
